title: The Best Ten, 18 February 1988
notes: TBS (JOKR-TV) music show, VHS off-air; Dunlop idents into the 9 pm time signal and the title fanfare, the tenth-place flip board with its points, a satellite remote from a cornfield in New South Wales (date, 30 degrees, a map of Australia), ranks 20 to 18 read with their trajectory graphs, a roller-skating idol group's O/X quiz with the audience screaming, and ten seconds mid-song of the week's number one; five of six windows are talk, one is sung; baked distortion 0.5
